grh_61dd1b8e8fe16969d301.title: The Flight of the Starbird
paragraphs: Balloonist Gloria Travis prepares the Starbird for a competitive flight with instructor Chad and her sixteen-year-old niece Sally nearby. Determined to gain an advantage, Chad maneuvers Sally into the basket and launches before Gloria has knowingly approved the plan. He then pushes the flight toward the mountains despite an approaching storm, forcing the balloon to climb into thin air and eventually carrying it beyond the mountains and out over the Pacific. As the exhausted crew tries to descend, Sally catches Chad pulling the wrong line before he can open the balloon's rip panel. The Starbird survives long enough for help to reach them, and Sally's quick observation proves crucial to bringing the reckless flight to a safe end.

grh_61712ca7fd6e66153ab8.title: The Blue Caribou
paragraphs: Near San Marino, Harry meets Jennifer, an American whose valuable blue caribou figurine has been stolen from her hotel. His search leads to an antique shop connected with Louis de Julio and managed by a man Harry recognizes as a former black-market operator. Harry discovers that valuable pieces from cheap lots entrusted to the shop have been quietly diverted and sold to an accomplice, and the missing blue caribou is among them. After a confrontation with the men involved, Jennifer recovers the figurine. Harry gets no profit from the case and instead spends his borrowed Swiss francs taking Jennifer skiing.

grh_613a330a946c8bece0ca.title: Eddie Jenkins and the Arsonist
paragraphs: Teenager Eddie Jenkins is burned in a waterfront gasoline fire and immediately becomes a suspect because he was found at the scene, although he insists he was sleeping beneath the pier and heard someone in the warehouse before the blaze. Kildare establishes that Eddie's headaches and truancy stem from poor eyesight, then realizes someone is trying to silence him when poisoned chocolates trigger violent convulsions; a recorded voice identifies the warehouse owner Maxon as the man Eddie heard, and when Maxon comes to the hospital with a gun, orderly Wayman knocks him down with a monkey wrench and ends the arsonist's attempt to kill the witness.
